title: Sustainable shelf-life extension of date palm–bael–jujube beverages through HTST pasteurization and protective packaging
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00683J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pitchaya Tuntiteeraboon, Saeid Jafari, Sochannet Chheng, Khursheed Ahmad Shiekh, Isaya Kijpatanasilp, Kitipong Assatarakul
This study evaluated packaging (transparent vs. amber glass) and pasteurization (LTLT vs. HTST) on a date palm–bael–jujube beverage. HTST in amber glass best preserved bioactives and ensured microbial safety, with a shelf life of 7 weeks at 4 °C.
